newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn says unlikely Germans among Yemen kidnapped.
newsitem.headline: Bonn says unlikely Germans among Yemen kidnapped.

text.p: The German Foreign Ministry said on Thursday first indications showed that Germans were not among a group of tourists abducted in Yemen.

A spokeswoman for the ministry said the German embassy in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa had information suggesting it was unlikely that Germans were involved. The embassy was seeking further information, she added.

Earlier reports from security and diplomatic sources in Sanaa had said five or six European tourists, either Germans or Italians, were kidnapped by tribesmen while on a tour in the Abyan governate and taken to Shabwa in central Yemen.
The Italian Foreign Ministry later said that 10 Italians had been abducted in two incidents in Yemen.
In March, four German holidaymakers were kidnapped. Earlier that month a group of seven German motorcycle tourists was also abducted.
